items.html:
Freddie Klokker is a hard-hitting top-order wicketkeeper-batsman who made his debut for Denmark as a teenager and has remained in the side since. He first played at the 2001 ICC Trophy, and at the 2005 event he carried his bat for a career-best 138 not out against USA. After four years on the MCC groundstaff - longer than usual but Clive Radley, the head coach, admitted he was "a bloody good bloke to have around" -, in 2006 he made 40 in his only Championship appearance for Warwickshire, and in 2007 he moved to Derbyshire where he hit 100 not out on his debut at Cambridge.
Martin Williamson August 2007
